projects.title: CodeNest — Cloud IDE
projects.one_liner: A browser-based code editor with Docker, terminal, and live preview. Live at project-idx-clone.vercel.app.
projects.problem: New developers lose hours configuring local toolchains before writing code.
projects.approach: Ship the environment with the code: per-session Docker containers, React workspace with terminal and live preview, session-scoped sync.
projects.note: Setup-time and feedback-cycle figures are self-reported testing notes.

projects.title: Realtime Team Chat (Slack-like)
projects.one_liner: A real-time chat app with login, private chats, payments, and file uploads.
projects.problem: Team chat must feel instant while handling auth, permissions, uploads, payments and background work.
projects.approach: Socket.IO event layer for messaging; REST for the rest; Bull queues for async work; S3 for media; RBAC at API and socket layers.
projects.note: Sub-200ms latency figure is a self-reported testing note.

projects.title: Document Flow & Alerts
projects.one_liner: A document upload app with login roles, deadline tracking, and email reminders.
projects.problem: Client document workflows miss deadlines when uploads, reviews and reminders live in disconnected tools.
projects.approach: Role-scoped uploads with deadline metadata, cron-driven NodeMailer reminder sweeps, and a dashboard surfacing what is due.
projects.note: Deadline/search improvement figures are self-reported testing notes.

projects.title: Bad-Posture Detection
projects.one_liner: A full-stack app that watches your sitting posture and shows it on a dashboard.
projects.problem: Desk workers develop strain with no feedback loop on sitting posture.
projects.approach: Stream pose signals to an inference endpoint; render live posture state, history and alerts.

projects.title: Video Calling App
projects.one_liner: A video calling app with rooms, built fully in TypeScript.
projects.problem: Browser calls need reliable signaling and room state before media can flow.
projects.approach: Typed signaling backend for rooms and offer/answer exchange; TypeScript frontend for peer connections and call UI.

projects.title: CLI Agent (Python)
projects.one_liner: An AI agent for the terminal. It takes plain-English requests and runs tasks with tools.
projects.problem: Repetitive terminal workflows need manual step-by-step operation.
projects.approach: LLM reasoning loop in a CLI with a tool registry for multi-step task execution.

projects.title: Tic Tac Toe (React)
projects.one_liner: Two-player Tic Tac Toe in React 19 + Vite with win/draw detection. Playable live.
projects.problem: Learning real React state via a classic game: turns, win state and reset must stay in sync.
projects.approach: Board as a single state array, derived winner/draw per move, UI as a pure function of state.

projects.title: Ping Pong Game
projects.one_liner: Two-player browser Pong with keyboard paddles and live scoring. Playable live.
projects.problem: Game feel needs a tight loop: input, ball physics, collision and score updating smoothly.
projects.approach: JS game loop for ball/paddle positions, keyboard input, collision checks, scoreboard with rounds.

projects.title: Snake Game
projects.one_liner: Classic Snake in vanilla JS — eat, grow, chase a high score. Playable live.
projects.problem: Snake needs precise grid movement, growth, collision and food-spawn logic to feel right.
projects.approach: Grid loop with snake body as a queue, food on free cells, wall/self collision every tick.

projects.title: Hangman Game (React)
projects.one_liner: Word-guessing Hangman in React 18 + Zustand + Tailwind with lives and round states.
projects.problem: Round state (guesses, masked word, lives, win/lose) must never desync.
projects.approach: Zustand store for round lifecycle, masked word derived from guesses, pure win/lose checks.

projects.title: Simon Say Game
projects.one_liner: Simon-style memory game in vanilla JS — repeat the growing color sequence.
projects.problem: Must flash, listen and validate in exact order without out-of-turn input.
projects.approach: Separate game vs. user sequences, one new color per level, click-by-click validation.

projects.title: Tic Tac Toe (Vanilla JS)
projects.one_liner: Dependency-free Tic Tac Toe in plain HTML/CSS/JS — zero build step.
projects.problem: Small games should load instantly with no toolchain.
projects.approach: Plain DOM grid with direct handlers and inline win-check.
